mapper.select: SELECT project_id as projectId, student_id as studentId, project_name as projectName, tech_stack as techStack, responsibility as responsibility, project_highlights as projectHighlights, create_time as createTime FROM project_experience WHERE student_id = #{studentId} ORDER BY create_time DESC
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM project_experience WHERE project_id = #{projectId} AND student_id = #{studentId}
